_doc: 1v1 (PLAN §6.2; research/round_flow.md §12, Siege's 1v1 Arcade v2 [Y11S2.2]): one player a side, 6 rounds, first to 4, one overtime round at 3–3 (max 7, siege.gg); no bans but attrition: "winning players can no longer select the Operator they used in the previous round" (official); prep 15 s (official); the site revealed at round start (official); a pool of 6 reinforcements (official), which the D-015 scaling gives one defender. The sides swap at round 4, as in Bomb's standard rules ("same ruleset as Bomb mode") and the 3v3 Arcade (siege.gg): attrition only matters to a player who plays the same side two rounds running (the Arcade's own pattern is unverified, D-121; Siege's Custom 1v1 Short Match preset swaps every round instead [Y9S3]). The defender picks the site. Action, plant, fuse and disable are Bomb's ("same ruleset as Bomb", official) but not confirmed for the Arcade; the pick time and the round-end banner are ours.
